fusions.name: Nibbling Swarm
fusions.desc: Swats every enemy within 2 tiles; each hit deals 3 damage, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pillaging Bite
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and costs 4% of your maximum health. Its damage rises +10% for every 10% of health the target still has (max +40%).

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Fat of the Field
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
